title: Let's Learn English Lesson 16
subtitle: Where Are You From?
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 16: Where Are You From? (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Washington, D.C. has many tourists! People from different countries come here. Today, my job is to interview tourists. I have to learn why they come here. This is very exciting! Excuse me. I'm Anna Matteo from The News. Do you have time for an interview?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！華盛頓特區有很多遊客！不同國家的人都會來這裡。今天我的工作是採訪遊客。我要了解他們為什麼來。這很令人興奮！打擾一下。我是《新聞》的安娜·馬特奧。你有時間接受採訪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: Sure, I have time.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: My name is Sabrina.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What country are you from?

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: I'm from Bangladesh.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, you are Bangladeshi.

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: That's right! My nationality is Bangladeshi.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Do you like Washington, D.C.?

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: Yes! The city is very beautiful!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you like to do in Washington D.C.?
dialogue.zh: 你在華盛頓特區喜歡做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: I like history. So, I like walking around and looking at all the monuments and memorials. They make history come alive!
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡歷史。所以我喜歡四處走走，看那些紀念碑和紀念堂。它們讓歷史活了起來！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington has many monuments and memorials. The Washington Monument is behind us! Which is your favorite?
dialogue.zh: 華盛頓有很多紀念碑和紀念堂。華盛頓紀念碑就在我們身後！你最喜歡哪一個？

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: I really like Lincoln Memorial. It is very beautiful. And it feels like Abraham Lincoln is still alive.
dialogue.zh: 我很喜歡林肯紀念堂。它很漂亮。感覺亞伯拉罕·林肯還活著。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome. Thank you for your time, Sabrina!
dialogue.zh: 太好了。謝謝你抽時間，薩布麗娜！

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: You're welcome.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's find another tourist.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! Excuse me. I am Anna Matteo from The News. Do you have time for a couple of questions?
dialogue.zh: 哦！打擾一下。我是《新聞》的安娜·馬特奧。你有時間回答幾個問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: Sure!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Are you from Washington, D.C.?

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: No, I'm not.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What is your name and where are you from?
dialogue.zh: 你叫什麼名字，來自哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: My name is Louis. And I'm from China.
dialogue.zh: 我叫路易斯。我來自中國。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What languages do you speak?

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: I speak Chinese and English.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you like about Washington DC?
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡華盛頓特區的什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: I like the museums. I really like the art museums.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡博物館。我特別喜歡藝術博物館。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Many of the museums are free.
dialogue.zh: 很多博物館都是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: I like that too!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome! Thanks for your time, Louis.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！謝謝你抽時間，路易斯。

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: You're very welcome. Bye!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now, let's find another tourist!
dialogue.zh: 現在，我們再找一位遊客！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! I am Anna Matteo from The News. Do you have time to answer a couple of questions?
dialogue.zh: 你好！我是《新聞》的安娜·馬特奧。你有時間回答幾個問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: Sure!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What is your name and where're you from?
dialogue.zh: 你叫什麼名字，來自哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: My name is Mehrnoush. I am from Iran. I'm Iranian.
dialogue.zh: 我叫梅爾努什。我來自伊朗。我是伊朗人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What language do they speak in Iran? Is it Persian?
dialogue.zh: 伊朗人說什麼語言？是波斯語嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: They speak Farsi.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you like to do in Washington DC?
dialogue.zh: 你在華盛頓特區喜歡做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: Well, I like learning about government and politics.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我喜歡瞭解政府和政治。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington has many politicians!

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: It does! I want to see the U.S. Capitol.
dialogue.zh: 是的！我想去看美國國會大廈。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Look, you are very near.

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: I am!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Have fun!

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: Thanks!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There you have it. Tourists from all over the world come to Washington, D.C. They all like doing and seeing different things in the city. This is Anna Matteo reporting for The News. Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。世界各地的遊客都會來華盛頓特區。他們喜歡在城裡做的、看的都不一樣。我是安娜·馬特奧，為《新聞》報道。下次見！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Is that okay? Awesome! Now, I want to do my favorite thing in the city … ride the carousel!
dialogue.zh: 這樣可以嗎？太好了！現在我想做城裡我最喜歡的事……坐旋轉木馬！

quiz.prompt: What does Mehrnoush want to see?
